content: I need help sorting out a hotel overbooking issue during my Europe trip.

I’m sorry to hear about the hotel overbooking issue during your Europe trip. Could you please provide more details about the situation, such as the hotel name, booking dates, and what resolution you’re hoping for? This will help me assist you better.

Since the property acknowledged the overbooking and later proposed another hotel, you can request equivalent or better accommodation plus transport coverage. Your Gold loyalty status may also support compensation requests.
The replacement property is farther from the conference venue than my original booking. I need wording to push back.
Please arrange a replacement hotel closer to the conference venue or provide transportation support due to the inconvenience.

You can state that the proposed relocation materially changes the convenience and value of the reservation because your meetings are near Roma Termini. Request either a comparable nearby property or reimbursement for all transit expenses.
Under what name did the traveler book through Booking.com?
I don't know
The reservation was made under the name Omar Siddiqui.
The hotel says Grand Verdi Suites is an upgrade because breakfast is included, but the commute is longer.
The Grand Verdi Suites includes breakfast but is farther from the conference, increasing your commute time.
You can argue that a complimentary breakfast does not offset the increased commute burden, especially when the original booking location was chosen for conference access.
I also want compensation points added to my loyalty account.
Request compensation points be added to your loyalty account due to inconvenience from hotel relocation and commute increase.
What status does the traveler hold in the StayPlus loyalty program?
Gold loyalty status
You should mention that you hold Gold status in the StayPlus loyalty program.
The support agent is insisting they already solved the problem by offering another room category.
The offered room is farther, increasing commute burden; breakfast doesn’t sufficiently compensate for this inconvenience.

A room-category upgrade alone may not resolve the issue if the replacement hotel changes location quality, travel time, or trip logistics. Focus your complaint on equivalent overall value, not just room size.
I need a short paragraph demanding written confirmation that transportation costs will be covered.
Please provide written confirmation that all transportation costs due to the hotel relocation will be fully covered.
Near which station is the traveler attending a conference?
I don't know
You mentioned that the conference venue is near Roma Termini station.
The manager now says they can only reimburse transit after checkout instead of arranging it upfront.
The manager will reimburse transit costs after checkout, not arrange them upfront.
Ask them to confirm in writing that all reasonable transportation expenses related to the relocation will be reimbursed promptly upon receipt submission.
I also want to reject any downgrade attempts clearly.
Please confirm in writing full reimbursement of transit costs and no room downgrade will be accepted.
What star rating does the traveler refuse accommodations below?
I don't know
You specified that you will not accept accommodations rated below four stars.
The support team now says they can either refund everything or keep the Grand Verdi Suites option available.
The support team offers either a full refund or keeping the Grand Verdi Suites option available.
You can respond that you are willing to consider the alternate accommodation only if it remains comparable in quality and does not create extra transportation costs.
Before I send the final escalation, summarize the replacement property they proposed.
They proposed the Grand Verdi Suites as the replacement property.
What was the alternate hotel offered later?
Grand Verdi Suites
